Payroll Representative enables a best-in-class employee experience through payroll knowledge & service delivery. This role will support the payroll delivery for Germany in the EMEAI region. The main objective of this role is to ensure that the employees are paid on time and accurately, in compliance with the respective country tax-legislation, agreed labor conditions, company policies and regulations. In this role, you will require understanding of key business drivers for your discipline and function. You will need to be able to expand conceptual and working knowledge related to German Payroll. Requires full proficiency gained through job-related training and considerable on-the-job experience to perform a range of tasks under limited supervision. It is your responsibility to use technical experience, established practices, and personal judgement to analyze and resolve straightforward problems. Your performance impacts the quality of your own work and your team’s work and requires that you work within established guidelines and policies What’s your job about? Delivering Payroll, Time & Absence, and Data Management in a productive and efficient manner. Processing information with confidentiality and with a high level of accuracy. Ensuring accurate and timely payments to employees and local authorities. Perform activities according to the Dow internal control & compliance framework. Address employee queries/cases on payroll related matters in alignment with our internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs) What skills do you have? You have a Bachelor or Master's degree in HR, Finance, or related area. You bring a minimum of 2 years of payroll experience. Fluency in English & German (written & oral) is mandatory. Preferred Skills: Experience with MS Excel, Workday, ServiceNow & ADP Globalview payroll, SAP. Proficiency in any other European languages is an asset. Understand organizational interdependencies and experience working across functions and cultures. Experience i

high volume operational environments is required. Experience in internal controls through prior audit participation is preferred. Good problem solving, critical thinking skills and managing competing priorities. By nature, this job requires a substantial amount of coordination with a variety of internal- and external stakeholders where accountability and ownership of data and processes are key. Self-motivated with a customer service mindset. What do you get in return? Competitive Salary 13th month Travel and any tunnel costs will be reimbursed 28 vacation days This international organization distinguishes itself through its strong focus on innovation, technological expertise, and sustainable development. By combining knowledge, experience, and a global network, the organization develops high-quality solutions that contribute to the growth and continuity of its customers, partners, and society. Professionals from a wide range of disciplines work closely together within the organization, including supply chain, research and development, manufacturing, engineering, health and safety, sustainability, information systems, finance, and human resources. The combination of diverse backgrounds, areas of expertise, and cultures creates a dynamic working environment in which collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are key. With a strong international presence and an extensive network of operational and support functions, the organization supports customers and partners around the world. By bringing together expertise and fostering close collaboration across different departments, innovative, efficient, and sustainable solutions are developed to address the challenges of today and tomorrow.

 Do you want to use your laboratory experience outside the lab and contribute to innovative solutions in Life Sciences? Then we are looking for you! 
Wilten Instrumenten BV has been active for over 70 years as a supplier of high-quality instruments for laboratories in the Benelux.  What will you do? 
As a Life Sciences Product Specialist, you are the face of Wilten to our customers. You: - Visits labs and build lasting relationships with researchers and lab managers; - Advises on application possibilities of our products based on your content knowledge; - Supports demonstrations, training and implementations; - Identify market trends and translates them into opportunities for Wilten. 
 Who are we looking for? 
A proactive and knowledgeable professional with: - A completed college or university degree in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Life Sciences or similar; - Minimum of 3 years practical laboratory experience with techniques such as Western Blot, qPCR, ELISA and Imaging; - Strong communication skills and a solution-oriented attitude; - Independence, diligence and a flexible work attitude; - Good command of Dutch and English, verbal and written.
